status: x-y-time-only fine-place x speed-turn feasibility preflight frozen before vertical outcomes
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism discrimination; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims
question: Can comparisons be conditioned simultaneously on fine horizontal place and the frozen speed×turn kinematic state without collapsing support?

feasibility.target_stratum: fine horizontal cell × frozen speed×turn state
feasibility.target_support: A target kinematic endpoint is supported when its fine-cell × state stratum occurs in at least one other session of the same individual and in at least one session from another individual in the same cohort.
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one retained target session with >=50 supported endpoints
feasibility.selection_rule: Choose the first (finest) candidate for which every panel retains at least 70% of its kinematic-state baseline evaluable individuals and at least 5 individuals. If none passes, do not open a five-panel fine-place×kinematic vertical outcome.

planned_test_if_feasible.fine_route_hypothesis: Residual vertical individuality is largely generated by individuals using different fine horizontal routes/patches within the same coarse context.
planned_test_if_feasible.within_fine_context_hypothesis: Individual vertical organization remains non-exchangeable even after identical fine-place × speed×turn-state weighting.
planned_test_if_feasible.estimator: P(centered residual height | selected fine cell, speed×turn state), with equal-session self, equal-individual other, and identical self-derived joint-stratum weights.
planned_test_if_feasible.calibration: Reuse frozen whole-session permutation B/seeds from kinematic-state-conditioning-v1.
planned_test_if_feasible.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight-selected n; calibrated identity >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05

claim_boundary: Fine cells are spatial matching strata, not verified feeding patches or routes.
Persistence does not prove intrinsic morphology, memory, learning or personality.
Failure can reflect power/support loss and is not itself proof of route allocation.
This extension remains outside the frozen v0.3.8 submission package.
stop_rule: Do not change state definition, grid priority 500/1000/2000 m, 70% retention, >=5 floor, 50-event support, or support definition after preflight output.
Do not inspect vertical outcomes while selecting the fine grid.
If no grid passes all five panels, stop the five-panel family before any vertical output.
